espn-604004.headline: Both lost 43–21 to New Zealand. One keeps sixth
beats: Scotland lost 21–43 to New Zealand at Murrayfield on 7 November. Ewan Ashman scored a hat-trick, then the hosts failed to score in the second half. Australia lost by the same score to New Zealand in October and conceded 45 at Twickenham last weekend.
Sione Tuipulotu, Scotland's Australia-born captain, calls the visitors a "wounded team". He is not pretending his own side is anything else: "That performance wasn't good enough."
Scotland won 27–13 when the sides last met, in 2024, and the Hopetoun Cup is theirs to keep. An Australian win by any margin takes them above Scotland into sixth in the world.
Afterwards Scotland host Japan while Australia go to Wales, which is a better week to be nursing a defeat in Edinburgh than in Cardiff.

espn-604005.headline: Wales beat New Zealand. England get the reply.
beats: New Zealand lost 35-28 in Cardiff on 14 November, their first defeat by Wales in 73 years. Eddie Jones, whose Japan side had just conceded 78 to England, has told them to expect a "violent" New Zealand.
Dave Rennie did not blame luck. His side had plenty of possession and territory, were held up three times after the break, and he called them "a little bit disconnected".

England arrive on four straight wins, the last of them 78-15 over Japan, with Will Joseph scoring five tries on his first cap in four years. They also won the last meeting at home, 33-19, on 15 November 2025.
A New Zealand win by 16 or more puts them back on top of the world rankings, which would be one way to forget Cardiff.

espn-604006.headline: After Twickenham's 78, Japan get Murrayfield
beats: England scored 13 tries past Japan on 14 November, and Japan had a man sent off before they had touched the ball. The cameras kept finding Eddie Jones in the coaches' box after each try.
The week before that, Japan lost to Wales by seven. Scotland's defence is no wall either: 43 conceded to Ireland in March, and 43 again to New Zealand at Murrayfield on 7 November.

Warner Dearns left Twickenham as one of the most impressive players on the field despite the 78, so Japan have a standout to build around. If they win by 16 or more, Scotland drop below Australia and Argentina.
Scotland have Italy at home in February. Japan have no game scheduled after this one, so Edinburgh is the last impression they leave for now.

espn-604007.headline: Ireland's scrum has had a year to think about this
beats: South Africa won 24–13 in Dublin last November, and the scoreline was the kind part. Ireland's scrum was dominated and five Irish players were carded, James Ryan among them with a 20-minute red.
Andrew Porter went almost a year without an Ireland cap after that game. He scored against Fiji, which settles nothing until South Africa's front row has had its say.
South Africa arrive off a 19–21 defeat in France. Ireland laboured to 43–15 over Fiji after briefly trailing. Win, and Ireland hand New Zealand top spot in the world rankings.
Ryan said Ireland were "not thinking about South Africa" while Fiji were in the way. That answer has now expired.

espn-604008.headline: Bottom of the table, ninth in the world on offer
beats: Italy and Fiji are the only two of twelve without a win, and their points differences are three apart. Fiji are still ninth in the world, and Italy, at home in Udine, take that place with a win of any size.

Fiji conceded 54 in France and 43 in Ireland in successive weeks. Italy shipped 66 to South Africa, then lost 14–19 to Argentina in Genoa after dominating possession and territory in the first half, by Felipe Contepomi's own account.
Manuel Zuliani won two turnover penalties that day, a "gladiatorial effort" that Garbisi wasted when his last-minute penalty kick for touch went straight out.
Italy's next game is at Scotland in February. Fiji's is Spain at the World Cup in October 2027, which is a long time to sit on a result like this.

espn-604009.headline: France saw off South Africa. Argentina barely saw off Italy
beats: France beat South Africa 21–19 with Antoine Dupont wearing 10. They go into the last pool round a point clear of England at the top of the North, and the North's winner meets the South's top side in the grand final.
Argentina's 19–14 in Genoa was their first win since July. It came a week after a 42–12 beating in Ireland, and Italy had the means to win it late.
France are not whole either. Romain Ntamack's injury means a long absence. Lose here, and France would also drop below England in the world rankings, which is the wrong week to give England anything.
France won the last meeting 37–23 in November 2024. After this, Argentina's next game is at the World Cup, which leaves a long time to think about how this one went.

espn-604010.headline: After the All Blacks, Wales have to do it again
beats: On 14 November Wales beat New Zealand 35-28 on this ground, ending 73 years and 34 straight defeats. Some bookmakers had offered 30-1 that week. The price on Australia will be shorter.
Beauden Barrett said "Their defence felt like a brick wall". Australia have lost their last three and conceded 45, 43 and 50 in them, which is not how you test a wall.
Win, and Wales go up to 9th in the world while Australia drop to 8th, behind an Argentina side that beat Wales 35-21 in July.
That same July, Wales failed to score against South Africa. The hard part of a famous win is the next one.
